entries.text: Implemented PO option (b): tests/test_dev_0_5b_auth_consumer_canonical_config.py's two collision-assertion tests now scan line-by-line and exempt a match only when its exact line's sha256 hash is catalogued in a new _KNOWN_PROSE_COLLISION_LINE_HASHES allowlist keyed by (file, line hash) -- exactly the two originally-named findings, nothing else. Line-number keying was rejected: build_history.json's matching line had already drifted from the originally-recorded line 47 to line 216 (append-only history growth) by the time of this fix. Non-generalization proved by two new tests: a fabricated new line in either named file is not exempted by file path alone, and a real new tracked file with a fresh colliding line is still caught end-to-end. Targeted: 10 tests, 8 passed / 2 failed. Full one-shot regression after merging origin/main: 2 failed, 3129 passed, 27 skipped -- NOT literal 0 failures.
